lesson: Chia mục tiêu vĩ đại thành từng nền móng khả thi mỗi ngày, giữ tâm bình tĩnh để áp lực lớn không lấn át niềm tin.

artwork.focal_object: Cầu đá vòm chạm khắc nối hai vách núi bách cổ dẫn tới lầu gỗ cổ điển
artwork.prompt: Traditional East Asian Gongbi fine-line ink and watercolor illustration isolated cleanly on warm cream aged parchment background (#FBF3E0), 3:2 horizontal composition, generous negative space. A majestic classical arched stone bridge with delicate carved balustrades spanning gracefully between two ancient cypress-crowned crags, a refined wooden pavilion rising solidly over curled golden-beige auspicious clouds. Crisp dark sepia ink outlines, mineral pigments of warm sandstone, malachite cypress green, antique wood brown, and muted gold, grand yet airy spot-illustration style, no border, no frame, no text, no numbers.
